steps: Step 2: Define DTOs in dto/ and TypeScript types in types/
Step 3: Extract pure business logic to logic/ with unit tests in tests/unit/
Step 4: Create isolated repository in repositories/ wrapping Prisma queries
Step 5: Create HTTP service client in services/
Step 6: Build Custom Hook in hooks/ to manage state and service calls
Step 7: Build clean View in views/ using src/ui/ components
Step 8: Export public API in index.ts and connect App Router page.tsx to <ModuloView />
